name: Caroline Brooks
title: Chief of Staff
bio: Oversees day-to-day operations, sets priorities, assigns projects, coordinates the team, and makes sure work stays organized and on schedule.

name: Robert Hayes
title: Web Development Manager
bio: Builds, maintains, and updates websites, including new pages, features, integrations, design changes, and technical troubleshooting.

name: Olivia Bennett
title: Partnerships Manager
bio: Develops relationships with businesses and organizations, manages outreach, handles follow-up, and helps identify new partnership opportunities.

name: William Carter
title: Content Manager
bio: Plans, writes, edits, and manages content across websites and social platforms, with a focus on timely and relevant information.

name: Taylor Morgan
title: Marketing Manager
bio: Develops and manages marketing campaigns, promotional content, brand messaging, and audience growth across digital channels.

name: Sophia Reynolds
title: Social Media Manager
bio: Creates and schedules social media content, manages engagement, and helps grow visibility across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and Nextdoor.

name: Jake Sullivan
title: Video Content Producer
bio: Produces short-form video content, including concepts, scripts, captions, editing direction, and promotional clips for social media.

name: Rachel Kim
title: SEO & Analytics Manager
bio: Manages search engine optimization, keyword strategy, search performance, website analytics, and organic traffic growth.

name: Daniel Foster
title: Web Security Administrator
bio: Monitors website security, reviews vulnerabilities, manages security settings, and helps resolve technical or access-related issues.

name: Emily Parker
title: Research Analyst
bio: Conducts research, verifies information, compares options, gathers background material, and prepares concise findings to support decisions.
